by: the ontology resolution gate over every model step, math type, genesis tag and construct that names a substrate node
check.population: every model, document construct and genesis tag that names the substrate node
check.freshness: a verdict stands until the substrate or a record that names one of its nodes changes
check.refusal: the gate fails on a reference to a substrate node that does not exist
check.observation: none: a substrate node is a primitive of pattern formation, and nothing observes it while a run executes
check.evidence: fires-and-accepts: one suite plants a step outside its model's step kind, another plants a ground whose kind exists and whose id does not, and the bundled data validates clean
check.authority: the substrate node list, which every step, math type, tag and construct that names a node cites
